source.title: 2026 Fantasy football deep sleepers: Tyler Shough and Tre Tucker are steals
source.author: Heath Cummings
source.summary: Uses projection-versus-ADP gaps and plausible upside scenarios to identify players available outside the top 150.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Cummings projects Shough near QB14 with substantial touchdown growth and sees additional second-half upside if Jordyn Tyson returns healthy.
takeaways.rationale: Cummings projects Shough near QB14 with substantial touchdown growth and sees additional second-half upside if Jordyn Tyson returns healthy.
risks: Touchdown improvement and Tyson's health are assumptions.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Coker projects as Cummings' WR31 despite a Round 13 cost, supported by strong efficiency and more planned slot usage.
takeaways.rationale: Coker projects as Cummings' WR31 despite a Round 13 cost, supported by strong efficiency and more planned slot usage.
risks: Carolina still has competition for targets.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Willis' rushing projection gives him upside well beyond QB23 even if Miami remains a weak offense.
takeaways.rationale: Willis' rushing projection gives him upside well beyond QB23 even if Miami remains a weak offense.
risks: Passing environment may be among the league's weakest.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Schultz is projected for another 100-plus targets and sits only a few points behind the TE9 projection despite a TE13 price.
takeaways.rationale: Schultz is projected for another 100-plus targets and sits only a few points behind the TE9 projection despite a TE13 price.
risks: A top-eight outcome requires improved touchdown luck.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Tucker appears established as Las Vegas' WR1 and projects roughly 50 picks ahead of his ADP.
takeaways.rationale: Tucker appears established as Las Vegas' WR1 and projects roughly 50 picks ahead of his ADP.
risks: The Raiders' passing environment remains a concern.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: If fully recovered from his ACL tear, Bell may be Miami's most talented receiver and a final-round upside play.
takeaways.rationale: If fully recovered from his ACL tear, Bell may be Miami's most talented receiver and a final-round upside play.
risks: ACL recovery and an unsettled offense.
